data.case_title: Working hours increase – Beispielsoft Solutions GmbH
data.title: Employment contract amendment: weekly hours rise to 40 from January 2027
data.summary: Beispielsoft Solutions GmbH's People & Culture team informs Harriet Collins that her weekly working hours will increase from 32 to 40 from 1 January 2027, with her salary adjusted accordingly, and asks her to sign and return one copy of the enclosed contract amendment by 11 December 2026.
data.explanation: Your employer wants to formally increase your contracted hours from 32 to 40 per week starting 1 January 2027, with a corresponding pay adjustment. A contract amendment is enclosed with the letter. You need to sign both copies and send one back to People & Culture by 11 December 2026 so payroll can apply the change in time. If you miss this date, the hours/salary change may not be processed for January as planned — check with People & Culture if you need more time or have questions about the new terms.

change.quote:
As agreed in your review meeting, your weekly hours will rise from 32 to 40 from 1
January 2027, with your salary adjusted accordingly.

that payroll can apply the change in January.
